bias.en: Bearish, improving · above the October closes, under the SAR
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · 站上 10 月收盘区，仍低于 SAR

read.en: ASML rose 1.7% on Oct 28 to $1,662.85, trading between $1,647.81 and $1,673.02. It is above the falling 5-day ($1,604.3) and 10-day ($1,627.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,593.7), and below the falling 30-day ($1,717.2) and 100-day ($1,745.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,711.20), and RSI is 47.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 10月28日上涨 1.7%，收于 $1,662.85，盘中区间 $1,647.81–1,673.02。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,604.3）和 10 日均线（$1,627.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,593.7）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$1,717.2）和 100 日均线（$1,745.7）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,711.20），RSI 为 47。

read.en: The close cleared the $1,641–1,657 band of Oct 14–19 closes, now support; the $1,673 high stopped short of the Oct 21 high. Resistance is $1,676.7–1,687.8 (Oct 21 close and high), then $1,711–1,717 (SAR, 30-day) and $1,734.5 (Oct 14 high). Support is $1,641–1,657, then $1,627.5 (10-day) and $1,594–1,604 (200 and 5-day). A close above $1,687.8 would target $1,711–1,717; below $1,641, $1,627.

s.en: Oct 14–19 closes ($1,641.5–1,657.4), now support; Oct 28 low $1,647.8
